about: Role-title corpus for getRoleAdvice (OI-28), built 2026-11-21. Every title is a real job posting's own title, as the board served it, read from the fixtures named in each row's 'from' (public posting pages and feeds the board carries). Rows: every title among those fixtures' 4,068 English-script titles whose card changed between origin/main (4a3c2a0bd) and this build, and a seeded sample (seed 20261121) of 80 titles whose card did not change and 50 that get no card. 'main' is origin/main's card for the title, recorded by running its getRoleAdvice; 'expected' is the card whose tips fit the job, read by hand (null: no card fits, so the generic tips are right). A row main got right must stay right (the never-worse rule). Added at review (2026-11-21): every title in those fixtures, and every one of the board's 15,068 unique titles (the ops folder's free-scan-wave-corpora/review-_source/titles.json, public posting titles read 2026-11-01, and free-scan-wave-corpora/S13-092/corpus.json), whose card changed between the lane's first build and this one, with 'Software Development Manager, Integrations' from that folder's postings.json (lever:air-tek), and 'Python Team Lead - AI & Automation', which the lane's first build had dropped to no card. A title that names a director, a head or a VP is labelled null whatever its seller's word ('AI Sales Director' was labelled sales_representative beside 'Director of Sales' at null; both are null now).
